_comment_velocity: vyaw_max raised from 1.2 to 12.0 to match the XGO mainboard's actual internal scale. With 1.2, commanded angular_z values quantize to a near-fixed mainboard byte, so the robot turns at a fixed ~1 rad/s regardless of commanded value (yielding ~15 cm radius circles always). With 12.0, the byte resolution covers 0–12 rad/s and commanded angular_z scales roughly 1:1 with the actual yaw rate. vx_max and vy_max kept at upstream defaults — translation appeared to scale roughly correctly.
